appStoreBlockers.issue: NO WORKING PAYMENT FLOW — TokenPurchaseModal is a simulated setTimeout. Apple requires functional IAP for digital goods. Google requires working billing. Both will reject.

Stripe Checkout via external browser (walletApi.ts purchaseTokens) — Apple PROHIBITS opening external payment links for digital goods on iOS. Must use StoreKit/IAP. This is explicitly against App Store Guidelines 3.1.1.
NO PRIVACY POLICY URL in app.config.ts — both stores require a privacy policy URL in app metadata.
Tab bar icons return EMOJI STRINGS instead of proper React components (e.g., `tabBarIcon: () => '🏠'`). This may render as text on some platforms and looks unprofessional for store review.

Location 'always' permission requested (UIBackgroundModes: ['location']) but no clear user-facing feature justification in the app for always-on location. Apple will ask for justification and likely reject without demonstrated use.
Multiple screens show 'Coming Soon' stubs (edit profile, security, help, earn, photos, wallet). Store reviewers will flag these as incomplete app.
No app icon assets verified — app.config references './assets/icon.png' and './assets/splash.png' but existence not confirmed. Missing icons = instant rejection.
VIP/Royal subscription flow is entirely TODO stubs. If subscription features are advertised but non-functional, Apple rejects.
NSFW/Adult content features referenced (AI_CHAT_CONFIG.NSFW_MESSAGE_COST, adult-content settings screen) — both stores have strict NSFW policies. Must be properly gated or removed.

No account deletion flow working — profile/settings/index.tsx shows 'This feature will be implemented soon' for delete account. Both stores now REQUIRE account deletion (Apple since 2022, Google since 2024).
